video:video.video:title: Implementation Lab: describe a task, Claude builds the workflow
video:video.video:description: A screen recording of the Ad On AI Academy Implementation Lab. A learner describes a repetitive task — turning meeting notes into a summary with action items and owners — clicks Build Workflow, and gets back a ready-to-run "Summarisation Workflow in Claude.ai" with a copy-ready Claude prompt, which they save to their Prompt Bank.

video:video.video:title: Every module makes an impact: from module to the team report
video:video.video:description: A screen recording of the Ad On AI Academy. A learner opens Module 6, Plan Your First AI Workflow, works through the workflow proposal checklist, and the team progress report shows the jobs they flagged on day one — chasing overdue invoices, the monthly variance report and the weekly debtor report — now handled by an agent, a workflow and a scheduled job.

video:video.video:title: Stuck on a step: a 1-on-1 with a Claude Certified trainer
video:video.video:description: A screen recording of the Ad On AI Academy. A learner writing their Module 6 workflow proposal gets stuck, uses the in-lesson Need help box to book a 1-hour call, accepts the support disclaimer, and works through the proposal with a Claude Certified trainer.
